High Court Of Madhya Pradesh

sentences.text: This is the first application filed by the applicants under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita , 2023/Section 439 of Cr.P.C., 1973 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.824/2024 registered at Police Station - Kotwali, District - Tikamgarh (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 419, 467, 468, 471, 120-B and 34 of IPC.

2. Learned counsel for applicants has submitted that as per the stay order passed by Division Bench of this Court in W.A. No.1971/2024 dated 20.02.2025, the trial court has dismissed the bail application filed on behalf of the applicants, whereas in the same situation, co-accused Mangal Das has been given the benefit of bail vide order dated 20.02.2025 in W.A. No.1971/2024.
It is further contended that at the time when the so called lease deed was issued, applicant no.1 was 16 years old.

It is further contended that applicants have no criminal record, hence, the applicants are entitled to be released on bail.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:12642 2 MCRC-7655-2025 3.
Learned counsel for State has opposed the bail application and prays for dismissal of the same.

4. Heard the parties and perused the case diary.
5.

Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case coupled with the fact that the trial will take time to conclude, this Court deems it appropriate to enlarge the applicants on bail, therefore,
without commenting on the merit of the case, the application is allowed.
